hints.title: Extreme Values Positioning
hints.text: The minimum element must move to index 0, and the maximum element must move to index n - 1.

hints.title: Tie-Breaking Indices
hints.text: To minimize swaps, choose the leftmost occurrence of the minimum value and the rightmost occurrence of the maximum value.

hints.title: Swap Overlap Adjustment
hints.text: If the chosen minimum index starts to the right of the maximum index, their paths cross, saving 1 swap.

hints.title: Index Distance Calculation Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minimumSwaps(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        min_val = min(nums)
        max_val = max(nums)
        min_idx = nums.index(min_val)
        max_idx = n - 1 - nums[::-1].index(max_val)
        swaps = min_idx + (n - 1 - max_idx)
        return swaps - 1 if min_idx > max_idx else swaps
```

complexity.notes: Single linear pass to locate extreme values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating individual swaps takes O(n) steps per swap, leading to quadratic overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies leftmost min and rightmost max positions and corrects for path intersection.
